name: Brown Rice Tofu Biryani
category: Healthy Rice, Millet and Grain Dishes
ingredients: ⅓ cup brown rice, soaked 30 minutes
1 bay leaf, 2 cardamom, 2 cloves and 1 cinnamon stick
1 tsp biryani masala and ½ tsp chilli powder
1 extra cup non-starchy vegetables (spinach, cabbage or green beans), chopped
steps: Marinate the tofu in the soy yogurt, half the biryani masala, chilli and salt for 20 minutes.
Add the extra chopped vegetables together with the other vegetables.
Cook the rice in plenty of salted boiling water with the whole spices for 20 minutes until 80% done; drain.
Heat the oil and cook the onion until deeply golden, about 10 minutes. Add ginger-garlic paste, vegetables and tofu, and cook for 6 minutes.
Layer the rice over the tofu; sprinkle with mint, coriander and remaining masala.
Cover tightly and cook on low heat for 15 minutes. Rest for 5 minutes and fluff.
note: Layered dum-style: browned onions and whole spices give the flavour with only 2 tsp of oil.
